name: sbom-diff
description: Diffs the deployed image's SBOM against the release candidate's

docker.customCommand: sh -c 'apk add --no-cache curl >/dev/null && curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anchore/syft/main/install.sh | sh -s -- -b /usr/local/bin v1.18.1 >/dev/null && pip install --quiet git+https://github.com/fabiocicerchia/sbom-diff@v1.0.1 && syft -q -o cyclonedx-json=/tmp/base.json registry:$IMAGE_REPO:$DEPLOYED_TAG && syft -q -o cyclonedx-json=/tmp/head.json registry:$IMAGE_REPO:$CANDIDATE_TAG && sbom-diff /tmp/base.json /tmp/head.json --fail-on major --max-added-transitive 10'
